profile.subtitleJa: ネバトの子。エフライム人で、ゼレダ出身と記される。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記上11:26は、ネバトの子ヤロブアムをエフライム人、ゼレダ出身、ソロモンの家来として紹介します。同節は母ゼルアがやもめだったことも記します。

facts.textJa: ソロモンは、若いヤロブアムが有能であると見て、ヨセフの家の労役を監督させます。
アヒヤはエルサレムを出たヤロブアムに道で会います。
アヒヤは衣を裂いて十片をヤロブアムに渡し、王国の十部族を彼に与えるという主の言葉を告げます。
ソロモンがヤロブアムを殺そうとしたため、彼はエジプトへ逃れ、ソロモンの死までそこにいます。
イスラエルの会衆はヤロブアムを呼び戻し、彼とともにレハブアムのもとへ来ます。
列王記上12:15は、アヒヤを通してヤロブアムに語られた主の言葉が実現する過程として、レハブアムの対応を説明します。
イスラエルの人々はヤロブアムを呼び、イスラエル全体の王にします。
ヤロブアムはシェケムを築き、そこに住み、さらにペヌエルを築きます。
ヤロブアムは、民がエルサレムへ戻れば王国がダビデの家に戻るのではないかと考えます。
ヤロブアムは第八の月の祭りを定め、ベテルの祭壇で犠牲をささげます。
ユダから来た神の人がベテルの祭壇に向かったとき、ヤロブアムはその祭壇のそばに立っています。
ヤロブアムは神の人を捕らえるよう手を伸ばしますが、その手は動かなくなります。
ヤロブアムは高き所の祭司を民の中から任命し続けます。
ヤロブアムの子アビヤが病気になります。
ヤロブアムは妻に変装してシロへ行き、預言者アヒヤに子のことを尋ねるよう頼みます。
アヒヤは、主がヤロブアムを民の中から引き上げ、イスラエルの指導者としたことを伝えます。
アヒヤはヤロブアムの家に下る裁きについて告げます。
アビヤだけが墓に葬られると告げられ、ヤロブアムの家の中で彼に良いものが見いだされたとされます。
主がヤロブアムの家を断つ王をイスラエルに立てるという言葉が告げられます。
イスラエルが引き渡される理由として、ヤロブアム自身の罪と、彼がイスラエルに罪を犯させたことが挙げられます。
ヤロブアムの妻がティルツァに戻ると、家の敷居で子どもが死にます。
ヤロブアムの戦いと治世のその他の出来事は、イスラエル王の年代記に記されたとされます。
ヤロブアムは22年間治めて死に、子ナダブが王位を継ぎます。
レハブアムとヤロブアムの間には絶えず戦争がありました。
ユダ王アビヤムの即位は、ヤロブアムの治世第18年に置かれます。
レハブアムとヤロブアムの間の戦争は、レハブアムの生涯を通じて続いたと記されます。
アビヤムの行いと、彼とヤロブアムとの戦争が記されます。
アサの即位は、ヤロブアムの治世第20年に置かれます。
ヤロブアムの子ナダブがイスラエルの王になります。
バアシャは王位に就くとヤロブアムの家を打ち、主の言葉に従ってその家を滅ぼしたと記されます。
ヤロブアムが犯しイスラエルにも犯させた罪が、主を怒らせた理由として述べられます。
バアシャの子エラはヤロブアムの道を歩んだと評されます。
主はバアシャに対し、ヤロブアムの道を歩み民に罪を犯させたと告げます。
バアシャの家がヤロブアムの家のようになると告げられます。
バアシャの悪が、ヤロブアムの家のようにするという主の言葉と関連づけられます。
ジムリの罪は、ヤロブアムの道を歩いたこととして記されます。
オムリはヤロブアムの道を歩き、その罪によってイスラエルに罪を犯させたとされます。
アハブはヤロブアムの罪を軽いことのように扱い、シドン人の王エトバアルの娘イゼベルを妻にします。
アハブの家に下る裁きは、ヤロブアムとバアシャの家にならうと告げられます。
アハブの子アハズヤは父母とヤロブアムの道を歩き、イスラエルに罪を犯させたと評されます。

sources.title: Jeroboam
sources.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, “Jeroboam,” CC BY-SA 4.0; accessed 2026-10-16T02:50:46Z.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.
At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.
He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you
Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;
and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from the LORD, that he might establish his word, which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.
Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.
Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.

Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.
Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the LORD’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.
This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.
Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

The LORD said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”
So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.
Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,

therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.
The dogs will eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field, for the LORD has spoken it.”’
All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.
Moreover the LORD will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.
He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”
Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.
There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.
Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.
Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;
for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

“Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,
behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

Moreover the LORD’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.
for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.
For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”
